title: Traditional British Sausage and Mash
description: A classic British dish made with sausages, mash, and a hint of smokiness. Perfect for a comforting meal.
instructions: Boil the sausages in water for 10-12 minutes, or until cooked through.
In a separate pot, boil the potatoes until tender, then mash with butter and milk.
Heat oil in a pan over medium heat. Add the smoked paprika and cook for 1 minute.
Add the cooked sausages to the pan and cook for 2-3 minutes, or until browned.
Serve the sausages with mashed potatoes and a dollop of zesty mustard.
Enjoy your delicious British-style sausage and mash!
